description: The code a Map Edits node writes and reads back (utils/mapEdits/mapEdits.ts). Jest checks mapEditsCode writes each case's `code` from its `edits` and `comments`, that readMapEdits reads it back to the same code, reads each `read` code as its `edits`, and refuses each `refused` code with a reason holding `reason`. utk_curio/sandbox/tests/test_map_edits.py checks Python reads each `cases` and `read` code's arguments as the same edits, and runs each `cases` code with curio_map_edits.

cases.name: a new node: no key and no edits yet, under the node's own comment lines
cases.code:
# Map Edits writes this code from its map: the features it removes and the
# values it changes, matched by the Id column. Comment lines above the return stay.
return curio_map_edits(
    input_0,
    remove=[],
    change={},
)

cases.name: the key picked, nothing edited yet
cases.code:
# Map Edits writes this code from its map: the features it removes and the
# values it changes, matched by building_id. Comment lines above the return stay.
return curio_map_edits(
    input_0,
    key="building_id",
    remove=[],
    change={},
)

cases.name: two buildings removed and one changed, in one layer of several
cases.code:
# Map Edits writes this code from its map: the features it removes and the
# values it changes, matched by building_id. Comment lines above the return stay.
return curio_map_edits(
    input_0,
    key="building_id",
    layer="table_osm_buildings",
    remove=[8, 10],
    change={34: {"height": 60}},
)

cases.name: several changes, one per line in the order they were made, with a value cleared
ids that are texts and numbers, floats among them: the text 12 is not the number 12
nested JSON values, written as Python literals
cases.code:
# Map Edits writes this code from its map: the features it removes and the
# values it changes, matched by building_id. Comment lines above the return stay.
return curio_map_edits(
    input_0,
    key="building_id",
    remove=[],
    change={34: {"tags": {"roof:shape": "flat", "levels": [1, 2.5]}, "flags": [True, False, None], "ratio": -0.5, "big": 1e+21, "tiny": 5e-7, "empty": {}, "none": []}},
)

cases.name: quotes, backslashes, line breaks, other scripts and a reference's brackets in texts
cases.code:
# Map Edits writes this code from its map: the features it removes and the
# values it changes, matched by building_id. Comment lines above the return stay.
return curio_map_edits(
    input_0,
    key="building_id",
    remove=[],
    change={34: {"name": "Tower \"B\" \\ 'C'", "note": "line\nbreak\ttab", "city": "São Paulo 東京", "sep": "a\u2028b", "chip": "[\x21! selection towers !!]"}},
)

cases.name: a comment line the user added stays, and the node's own lines name the key it has now

cases.name: no comment lines at all

read.name: single quotes, keywords in another order, spaces, line breaks and trailing commas
numbers as Python may write them: exponents, signs and floats that are whole
the escapes Python reads in a text
None leaves the key, the layer, the removals and the changes unset
read.code: return curio_map_edits(input_0, key=None, layer=None, remove=None, change=None)

read.name: the input alone, a space before the parenthesis and CRLF line ends

refused.name: a comment inside the call
a keyword the step does not take
a reference, whose value only a run knows
a value that is not written out
refused.reason: list is not a value written out

refused.name: one id changed twice, as 1 and as 1.0
a raw text
refused.reason: r is not a value written out

refused.name: an escape Python does not know
a whole number too large to read exactly
a number Python reads as infinity
a return that does not start its line
a call that is not closed
two texts side by side
refused.reason: an argument has no , or ) after it

refused.name: a set in place of a list
refused.reason: a key of a dict has no : after it

refused.name: a property name that is not a text
a tuple in place of a list
a whole number with a leading zero
a text cut by a line break
